# Object Info

Brings another scene object's geometry into your graph as a reference or an extra part.

`lfs.object_info` · Input

## How to use

Choose the exact name or UUID of the reference object.  
Use Relative space to place it relative to the object being modified.  
Avoid referencing an object that depends on this modifier.  

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Reference object's geometry in the chosen space, including its visible modifiers. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Object | `object` | string |  | — | Exact scene object name or UUID to read. Empty by default; choose a reference object before evaluating. |
| Transform Space | `transform_space` | enum | original | original; relative | Reference space. Original keeps local coordinates; Relative transforms into the modified object's space. |
